english_title: Integral of a Nonnegative Function Is Nonnegative
statement_en: If $h:\Omega \to \mathbb{R}$ is measurable and nonnegative almost everywhere, then its integral is also nonnegative.
key_techniques: definition of the Lebesgue integral for nonnegative functions
callout_body: $h:\Omega \to \mathbb{R}$是几乎处处非负可测的，那么其积分也是非负的。
